artifact_retention: Pull and review promptly; keep this run's private input/output prefixes at most 30 days without renewed storage approval.
authorization: Draft only: the user's explicit approval must name this SHA256 and cover its private uploads, one job and bounded storage
scope_exclusions: shop retention (deferred to final evaluation, amendment 7)

forecast.basis: t4-small $0.4/h; training at 266.5 tokens/s measured on one 4,072-token example; dev episodes at G0-02's per-episode times (3 tasks each). Planning estimates, not caps or measurements.
forecast.uncertainty: Throughput comes from 3 updates on one 4,072-token example; the 500 set averages ~1,783 tokens per example (less attention work per token, more fixed per-microbatch overhead). Dev times come from 3 tasks. Treat both as +/-50% until a full stage is measured.

pass_criteria: account, rate, pins and private upload verified; every training and dev reference passes before model use
fresh factory encoding matches the frozen 475/25 plan (847,065 inputs, 107,381 unique targets per pass)
60 finite committed optimizer updates via the AgentTune factory, none skipped; ledger covers all
validation losses finite; GPU memory events after load, every update, completion and any OOM
the dev step reloads the final adapter and its tensors exactly equal the saved step-60 adapter
95 dev episodes with one finite projected inference position; AuditKIT agrees with every saved score
abort_criteria: wrong account or higher hardware price
missing memory measurement, full-prompt inference projection or AuditKIT disagreement
reporting: Strict, fallback and set dev accuracy, submissions and no-table counts, tokens, time and cost are reported whatever they are. G1 and the 1,500 stage rule are computed only after both this run and the baselines run finish.
